note: The OLG covers most but not all of FNS 726.6. Three of the four mandatory-action triggers are addressed: (1) ABAWD hour changes — 'Simplified Reporting – Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance' requires reporting when hours fall below 20/week; (2) income exceeding gross income limit — covered extensively across multiple Simplified Reporting pages with detailed procedures; (3) three of four Method 2 conditions (voluntary closure, verified upon receipt, fleeing felon) are listed under 'Changes that May Be Acted Upon at Anytime.' However, several FNS requirements are missing: (a) substantial lottery/gambling winnings as a mandatory reporting/action trigger — the OLG never mentions this in the Simplified Reporting context; (b) the PA/GA grant change condition under Method 2 (FNS item 2d) is not addressed; (c) the exception for changes reported for another public assistance program that don't trigger action in that program is not mentioned; (d) the OLG does not present the two-method framework (act on all changes vs. act only on decreases) that FNS describes — it simply lists the 'anytime' actions without framing them as one of two options the state has chosen.
